trial.evidence: App Store description: “Try Ladder COMPLETELY FREE for 7 days. NO PAYMENT collected during trial.” Web pricing page: “FREE TRIAL 7 DAYS FREE” and “No payment info collected until AFTER your trial ends.”

ourRead: Annual leads with $14.99 a month, half of Monthly's $29.99, though $179.99 / 12 is $15.00. Only Annual gets a dark card and lime checks.
Annual costs less per month and does more: every team, unlimited team changes, unlimited Save & Replay. Monthly stops at 1 team and 2 changes a month.
The 7-day trial asks for payment only after it ends. The App Store lists 4 tiers at $179.99 to $479.99 a year; the web shows only PRO.

improvements.title: Put Annual first
improvements.detail: Annual, the one dark card, comes third and last, under Free Trial and Monthly. Move it to the top and print the 7 free days on it.
improvements.rule: Put the main actions at the top of the hierarchy, where the eye lands first.

improvements.title: Say what Annual saves
improvements.detail: Annual reads “Maximum flexibility, save monthly.” A 12-month plan is the least flexible one. Write “Half the Monthly price: save $179.89 a year”.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Use the app's flat black
improvements.detail: The pricing page uses 2 grey gradients: Annual runs #1B1B1B to #474747, Monthly #B6B6B6 to #FAFAFA. Fill Annual with the app's flat #0E0E0E and the other cards with white.
improvements.rule: Slop Check 7: Many shades and opacities of one color

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Ladder's style: a sticky header with the logo and a lime pill button, then 2 stacked cards, Annual first. Each card: bold caps plan name, huge price, small grey “/ month”, one line of copy, checklist. Annual is the one dark card: “7 days free” on top, $14.99 a month, $179.99 a year below, lime checks. Type: Archivo at weight 900 and width 125 for headlines and prices, Inter for body. Colors: white #FFFFFF (60) page, near black #0E0E0E (30) type and Annual, lime yellow #E6FF01 (10) button and checks. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
